name: 专注喝水
look_en: eyes half closed in focus, tongue lapping the water, ears relaxed

name: 好奇探头
look_en: eyes wide and round, whiskers forward, head tilted, leaning in

name: 安心熟睡
look_en: eyes fully closed, chin resting on the paws, body loose and curled

name: 慵懒半睁眼
look_en: eyes half open and sleepy, ears soft, body stretched out

name: 盯住目标
look_en: eyes locked on the moving hand or cloth, pupils slightly wide, ears pricked

name: 伸爪试探
look_en: one paw raised toward the rim, eyes fixed on the paw, ears forward

name: 满足舔嘴
look_en: just finished drinking, tongue licking the nose, eyes soft

name: 平视凝视
look_en: eyes level with the water, steady calm gaze, nose close to the surface

name: 放松张嘴
look_en: mouth softly open, relaxed tongue, bright eyes, tail mid-wag

name: 闭眼享受
look_en: eyes closed, face tilted up into the light, whiskers relaxed

name: 竖耳警觉
look_en: head up, ears pricked toward the movement, eyes alert

name: 歪头疑惑
look_en: head tilted to one side, one ear turned, eyes curious

name: 瞪圆眼伸舌舔
look_en: eyes huge and round with big pupils, tongue stretched far out mid-lick, whiskers pushed forward, paw gripping the edge
avoid: 学自用户截图（猫肉泥海报，未入库）；舌头不能伸进出水口

name: 耳朵飞起冲过来
look_en: ears flying back, mouth open in a happy pant, eyes wide and bright, caught mid-stride rushing toward the product

name: 鼻子贴近镜头
look_en: nose almost touching the lens, eyes big and curious, the face filling the foreground

name: 迈步凝视镜头
look_en: walking straight toward the camera, one front paw reaching forward, steady direct gaze into the lens

name: 委屈翻白眼
look_en: looking up with the whites of the eyes showing, brows pulled together, a grumpy pout
avoid: 只用于「没有它会怎样」那一半；不用在我方产品正在工作的画面

name: 惊喜瞪眼
look_en: eyes suddenly wide, ears shooting up, head pulled back a little in delighted surprise

name: 仰头张大嘴开心
look_en: head tipped up, mouth wide open in a big happy pant, tongue out, eyes squeezed with joy
avoid: 只用于狗；不用在喝水那一刻

name: 皱眉嫌弃
look_en: brows furrowed, nose wrinkled, a doubtful sideways look
avoid: 只用于「没有它会怎样」那一半
